version: 25.0 (vertical fog gameplay, audio polish, the map registry)
machine: Apple M5 laptop, Chrome, Balanced preset (60 FPS cap, render scale 1.25)

registry.tdmJungle: crashsite only, shown as DEEP JUNGLE (Thai flavor ป่าลึก)
registry.firebase: jungle: Survival only, shown as FIREBASE VIPER

groundFog.model: density D·clamp(1 − y/H, 0, 1)², D 0.256 /m, H 4.5 m; integrated along the camera-to-fragment segment in closed form; hidden = (1 − exp(−τ²))·0.96
groundFog.sightCap: both feet under 3 m: no bot sees past 13 m (Sensing pre-filter; the player's spotting too)
groundFog.routeBias: SMG and shotgun: fog links ×0.7, clear ×1.25; rifle: clear ×0.6, fog ×1.35; pistol neutral

selfPlay.method: tdmSim on Neon Block, 5v5, 25 tickets; kills by where both ends stood (ground: both feet under 3 m; roof: both over; across: one each); each gun's share of its time over 3 m

fogOff_4.note: the same build with the sight cap and the route bias off (tdmSim({ fog: false })): the 24.0 bots on this map

music.method: __dev.musicSpectrum: every layer of a theme rendered offline (OfflineAudioContext, mixed as PatternTheme mixes it: layer levels, theme gain; no limiter), then again through a 12 dB/oct high-pass at 1 kHz and at 2.5 kHz; 10 s at intensity 1
music.columns: above1kPct, above2_5kPct, rmsDb, peakDb (before the limiter)
music.note: the jungle's first cut rendered 2.7 dB over the 24.0 theme (gain 0.9 -> 0.62); a first measurement read only the reverb sends (the TrackBus output starts at 0) and was redone

neonblock.discarded: a first run's first five views (CPU 4.4-5.2 ms: the warm-up, L-140)

maglev.note: the patched fog chunks with the ground fog off: unchanged (22.0: 5.6-6.4)

memory.leakcheck: node scripts/leakcheck.mjs 2 neonblock,crashsite,desert: 0 alive, flat from lap 1
